name: process_integration
label: Set the Reference to the Integration Table for the Workflow
description: The process settings reference the integration table, which can be used for querying, filtering, and reporting on related process data.

fields.name: process_uuid
fields.description: Workflow UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: integration_uuid
fields.description: Integration with UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the process_uuid, integration_uuid fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_integration_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the integration_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
